mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT su.USER_NAME userName, su.REAL_NAME realName, to_char(NVL(a.totalWork,0),'fm999990.009') as totalWork, to_char(NVL(b.unfinishedWork,0),'fm999990.009') as unfinishedWork FROM SYS_USER su INNER JOIN SYS_USER_ROLE sur ON su.USER_NAME = sur.USER_ID INNER JOIN SYS_ROLE sr ON sur.ROLE_ID = sr.ROLE_ID AND sr.ROLE_POS in (06) LEFT JOIN ETR_DISTRIBUTE ed ON ed.TRADER=su.USER_NAME LEFT JOIN ( SELECT edi.TRADER as TRADER, round(COUNT(edi.TRADER),2) AS totalWork FROM ETR_DISTRIBUTE edi LEFT JOIN ETR_ENTRUST een ON edi.ENTRUST_ID = een.ENTRUST_ID where een.ENTRUST_STATUS in ('02','03','04') GROUP BY edi.TRADER) a ON su.USER_NAME = a.TRADER LEFT JOIN ( SELECT edi.TRADER as TRADER, round(COUNT(edi.TRADER),2) AS unfinishedWork FROM ETR_DISTRIBUTE edi LEFT JOIN ETR_ENTRUST een ON edi.ENTRUST_ID = een.ENTRUST_ID where een.ENTRUST_STATUS in ('02','03') GROUP BY edi.TRADER) b ON b.TRADER=su.USER_NAME

select listagg(ea.DISPENSE_PARA,',') WITHIN GROUP ( order by er.VDATE) distributeParameter, er.DISPENSE_RULE distributeRule, to_char(er.VDATE,'yyyy-MM-dd') vdate, to_char(er.MDATE,'yyyy-MM-dd') mdate from ETR_AUTO_DISPENSE_RULE er left join ETR_AUTO_DISPENSE_RULE_DETAIL ea on er.RULE_ID = ea.RULE_ID
and er.VDATE <= to_date(#{sysDate},'yyyy-mm-dd') and er.MDATE >= to_date(#{sysDate},'yyyy-mm-dd')
group by er.DISPENSE_RULE, er.VDATE, er.MDATE
